title: GitHub IntelliSolve: AI-Powered GitHub Ticket Analyzer & Automated Resolver

live_model.evidence: Sec.5.4: "root cause analysis via GPT-4 Turbo (gpt-4-turbo)"; Sec.7: "pilot on 50 SWE-Bench bug tickets shows GPT-4 summaries rated correct/partially correct in 84%".

prompt.note: Prompt only described as "combining the full preprocessed issue text, extracted code blocks, repository language, and the three most relevant prior resolved issues"; no literal template.

claim.location: Sec.7 Preliminary Results ("pilot evaluation on 50 randomly sampled SWE-Bench bug tickets")

notes: System-architecture paper (Docker/Kubernetes/FastAPI microservices) for an unreleased tool; the only quantitative result tied to GPT-4 Turbo is a small 50-ticket preliminary pilot with an undisclosed rating protocol, and no verbatim prompt is given.
